links.note: Image is the black monochrome logo of LAUNS & CO, with tagline 'Inteligência & Tecnologia'. Features bold sans-serif wordmark 'LAUNS', a stylized sun/rays icon on the left, a bicycle-like geometric symbol, and a registered trademark circle. All in solid black on white background.
The image resides under src/public/assets, the public-facing asset directory of the EducaTudo web application, indicating it is served as a UI asset for the platform.

The PNG file contains the visual representation of the Tudinha mascot: a 3D-rendered female character in Pixar/Disney animation style, with brown shoulder-length hair, round glasses with dark frames, green-hazel eyes, pearl earrings, and a white lab coat, set against a black background. The approachable, intellectual appearance matches the role of an AI tutor/assistant.
Tudinha is the named AI chat assistant of the EducaTudo platform (referenced in CLAUDE.md as 'Chat Tudinha' and 'OpenAI API' integration), serving as the product's AI tutor persona.

The file is located in src/public/static/images and named 'animacao-tuidnha', placing it as a publicly served UI asset representing the Tudinha chat assistant mentioned in CLAUDE.md under OpenAI integrations (Chat Tudinha).

The image is the official EducaTudo platform logo in its white/light-background variant. It features a stylized 'e' formed by a colorful spiral pencil (multicolor: purple, green, teal, blue, orange, red, pink) and the wordmark 'EducaTUDO' where 'Educa' is rendered in white and 'TUDO' in bright green. This is the primary brand asset for the educational SaaS platform.
